summary: Backend-only re-verification of the Wallet module after the route-ordering fix. Confirmed GET /api/wallet/refund-requests now returns HTTP 200 (was 422 prior to fix). Extended the wallet test suite from 15 to 21 tests covering the full refund-request workflow (create → enrichment fields → status=Pending filter → PATCH Approved → PATCH Completed → REFUND wallet transaction + balance decrement → invalid-status 400). All 21/21 tests PASSED. Parametric routes /api/wallet/{pid} and /api/wallet/{pid}/transactions still work — reorder did not break them. /api/wallets?min_balance=0 still returns >=7 active-patient rows.
critical_code_review_comments: Route-ordering fix at /app/backend/server.py:1960-2013 is correct and minimal — static-path routes for /wallet/refund-requests now precede the parametric /wallet/{pid:int}. Added a clarifying comment block — good practice.

Suggest adding a unit-level guard (e.g. a pytest that imports the FastAPI app and asserts no static segment is ever shadowed by a path-parameter route declared earlier) to prevent regression in the future as new /wallet/* endpoints are added.
server.py is still 4251 lines; consider splitting into modular routers (already flagged in iteration_1) — not blocking for this fix.

PATCH /wallet/refund-requests/{rid}/status — when transitioning Pending→Completed directly (without prior Approved step) the endpoint allows it; this matches the spec (`Must be Pending or Approved`). No issue, just confirming behavior.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_wallet_module.py (extended TestRefundRequests with 4 tests + new TestRouteShadowingRegression class — 6 new tests total)
test_credentials: admin/Admin@1234, manager/Manager@1234, accountant/Account@1234, foe/Foe@1234 — all working. Login endpoint: POST /api/login.
seed_data_creation: Each run credits patient 1 by ₹5000 + ₹200 (+ ₹1500 conditional) and creates 2 refund requests (one ₹1234 fully completed, one ₹100 left Pending used for invalid-status test). Tests are resilient to varying balance. TEST_Patient_<hex> created per run via POST /api/patients.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wallet module is fully green. Refund request workflow Pending→Approved→Completed is verified end-to-end including wallet REFUND transaction creation and balance decrement. Route shadowing for /wallet/refund-requests is fixed and the regression class (TestRouteShadowingRegression) guards against future breakage. Future testers can reuse /app/backend/tests/test_wallet_module.py as-is.
rca of the issue: Original bug (iteration_1): /wallet/{pid:int} declared before /wallet/refund-requests caused FastAPI to try int-parsing 'refund-requests' → HTTP 422. Fix applied in iteration_2: /wallet/refund-requests (GET) and /wallet/refund-requests/{rid}/status (PATCH) moved above /wallet/{pid} at server.py:1963 and 1979. Verified: curl GET /api/wallet/refund-requests → 200 [] (and 200 with rows after creating refund requests). All 21 pytest tests pass.
